title: $\textit{BlockFormer}$ : Transformer-based inference from genomic contact maps
abstract: arXiv:2605.21617v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Locating genomic features from genomic contact maps, such as centromere identification from genome-wide chromosome conformation capture techniques, notably Hi-C, can be formulated as an inverse problem: infer one parameter per entity given a map summarizing pairwise interactions through blocks of variable numbers and sizes. In this work, we introduce a data-driven approach that leverages shared structure between these contact maps, such as global alignment between localized patterns, while handling the variability in number and size of chromosomes arising in real-world data. Our approach relies on a transformer architecture capable of handling such variability and a custom simulator to generate abundant, yet computationally cheap synthetic data for training. translated_title: BlockFormer：基于Transformer的基因组接触图谱推断
translated_abstract: 从基因组接触图谱中定位基因组特征，例如利用全基因组染色体构象捕获技术（尤其是Hi-C）识别着丝粒，可以被表述为一个逆问题：给定一张通过数量和大小可变的区块总结成对相互作用的图谱，为每个实体推断一个参数。在本工作中，我们提出了一种数据驱动的方法，该方法利用这些接触图谱之间的共享结构（例如局部模式之间的全局比对），同时处理真实数据中染色体数量和大小的可变性。我们的方法依赖于一个能够处理这种可变性的Transformer架构，以及一个自定义模拟器，用于生成大量但计算成本低廉的合成数据用于训练。应用于着丝粒定位问题时，该方法能够在多种基因组大小的物种中，以等于或低于图谱分辨率的精度恢复基因组位置，采用由粗到（细）……
tldr: 提出BlockFormer，一种基于Transformer架构的数据驱动方法，结合自定义模拟器生成的低成本合成训练数据，从基因组接触图谱（如Hi-C）中高精度定位基因组特征（如着丝粒），并能灵活处理染色体数量和大小的可变性。
en_tdlr: BlockFormer is a Transformer-based, data-driven approach that leverages a custom simulator to generate cheap synthetic training data, enabling high-precision localization of genomic features (such as centromeres) from genomic contact maps like Hi-C while handling variability in chromosome numbers and sizes.
